limit.description: Max number of results to return

offset.description: Number of results to skip before returning

metadata_filters.description: List of filter objects applied against asset metadata fields before scoring. All filters are combined with AND.

skip_moderation.description: When true, moderation scoring is skipped and moderation_score will be null on all results.

text_query.description: Query text matched against transcripts. In semantic mode it is encoded into an embedding and ranked via vector similarity; in exact mode it is matched lexically without embedding.

match_mode.description: semantic: encode query with the dataset audio/transcript encoder; exact: pass text to the job without embedding for literal phrase matching.

key.description: Name of the metadata field to filter on (must exist on the dataset's assets).

value.description: Value to compare the metadata field against. Always provided as a string; numerical operators (>, <, >=, <=) parse it as a number.

search-metadata-filter_MetadataFilter.description: A single filter applied against an asset metadata field before scoring.
search-metadata-filter_MetadataFilter.title: MetadataFilter

search-metadata-filter_MetadataFilterOpe.description: Comparison operator applied between a metadata field value and the filter `value`.
search-metadata-filter_MetadataFilterOpe.title: MetadataFilterOperator

search-metadata-filter_TranscriptMatchMo.description: Transcript search: vector/semantic vs lexical/exact (exact skips query embedding).
search-metadata-filter_TranscriptMatchMo.title: TranscriptMatchMode
